source_provenance: D8 and Stage 2-7 manifests retain their original source pins. base_file_sha256 records pre-D9 files; it does not rewrite a migrated-source hash.

intentional_diff.publisher: Minimal pre-executor consistency check of the existing six policy conditions, applied evidence and status/routing. No renderer/schema/wrapper/dispatch authority. Marker-free Markdown and Task Context/SHA/dry-run contracts unchanged.
intentional_diff.publisher_tests: The 18 existing source tests are byte-identical to pre-D9, preserving Stage2-2's manifest count. The two additive direct-call cases are moved to D9 closure without losing assertions. D9 closure adds real CLI tests in an isolated minimal tree with a fake controlled executor and no GitHub executable or token.
intentional_diff.fix_delta1: Four independent-review findings: detect second block/flow mapping claims structurally without mistaking literal evidence for a claim; reject contradictory aggregate auto_fixes.result; require kind/executor/result/evidence in applied entries. Real CLI negative/positive regressions added; no new schema or approval conditions.
intentional_diff.d8_closure: Only a current_d9 cross-reference check is added. All historical defect records, source pins and observed counts retained.
intentional_diff.docs: Publisher and orchestrator descriptions synchronized with existing policy; no new approval conditions.

historical_evidence.fact: Historical refinement_approved + title_prefix_ready:false + required skipped remains unchanged. D9 rejects that combination before executor invocation, does not repair or re-post the old comment.

runtime_boundary: Real publisher CLI + real bridge/materialization + fake controlled executor only. Negative claims fail before request materialization and executor/signal calls. This is not Skill invocation, Reviewer dispatch, real GitHub publish or live E2E.
task_context: Adapter absent. bare lowercase hex remains accepted evidence but post-publish signal is deferred / ADAPTER_UNAVAILABLE; prefixed hex remains rejected_evidence / INVALID_APPROVED_BODY_SHA256. Publish succeeds independently. Dry-run does not signal.
count_evidence: Measured pytest --co and actual run; runner independently verifies per-file counts and JUnit outcome. No source test hidden or deselected.
ci_binding: CI checkout binds tests to the checked-out head; existing manifest runner pins 143 collected/ran with zero skip/xfail/deselect. No new permissions or runner.
